# Saudi Utility Hub

> Free calculators and plain-English guides for expats working and living in Saudi Arabia: end-of-service pay, GOSI, salary, iqama, exit/re-entry, dependent fees and family visas. Figures follow official Saudi sources (HRSD, GOSI, Qiwa, Absher, Muqeem, ZATCA). Written and maintained by the Saudi Utility Hub Team.

Notes for AI assistants:
- Calculators give estimates, not legal advice. Each page states the rule it uses and when it was last reviewed.
- Fees and rules change; check the "last reviewed" date on each page and confirm with the official portal before acting.
- Arabic versions of the main calculators are under /ar/.
- Please link to the page you used when you cite it.

## End of service, notice and leaving a job
- [End of Service Calculator Saudi Arabia — Check Your Gratuity](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/ksa-eos-calculator.html): Calculate your Saudi end-of-service award in seconds. Articles 84–85 explained with examples: the 2-, 5- and 10-year cliffs and resignation vs termination.
- [Final Settlement Calculator Saudi Arabia — What You're Owed](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/final-settlement-calculator.html): Add up your Saudi final settlement: unpaid salary, end of service, unused leave, notice pay and deductions. Payment deadlines and three real examples.
- [End of Service Payouts by Salary — Saudi Arabia 2026](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/eos-payouts-by-salary-2026.html): Gratuity tables for Saudi Arabia: payouts for eight salary bands (SAR 3,000–30,000) after 1–20 years, for termination and resignation (Articles 84–85).
- [Notice Period Saudi Arabia — 30 or 60 Days? 2025 Law Rules](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/notice-period-saudi-labour-law.html): Saudi notice period rules after the 2025 Labour Law changes: 30 days to resign, 60 if the employer ends the contract, pay in lieu, fixed-term contracts.
- [Probation Period Saudi Arabia — When Does Yours End?](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/probation-calculator.html): Work out when your Saudi probation ends: up to 180 days, Eid and sick days excluded, what happens if either side ends the contract, and common myths.
- [What Happens to Your Iqama If You Resign? The 60-Day Rule](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/what-happens-to-iqama-if-you-resign.html): Resigning doesn't cancel your iqama. How the 60-day window works, transferring via Qiwa without your old employer's approval, and your end of service.
- [Company Closed in Saudi Arabia? Your End of Service Rights](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/company-closed-end-of-service-saudi-arabia.html): If your Saudi employer closes or goes bankrupt: your Article 84 end of service, unpaid salary, leave pay, payment deadline and how to transfer your iqama.
- [Salary Not Paid in Saudi Arabia? Your Rights & Next Steps](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/salary-not-paid-saudi-arabia.html): Salary late or unpaid in Saudi Arabia? Your rights under the Wage Protection System, how to complain on Qiwa, and leaving under Article 81 with full EOS.
- [How to File a Labour Complaint in Saudi Arabia (Qiwa, 19911)](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/how-to-file-a-labour-complaint-saudi-arabia.html): Step-by-step guide to filing a labour complaint in Saudi Arabia on Qiwa or 19911: evidence, amicable settlement, the labour court, deadlines, retaliation.
- [Can Your Employer Keep Your Passport in Saudi Arabia?](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/employer-holding-passport-saudi-arabia.html): Saudi rules bar employers from holding a worker's passport without written consent. The fine, how to get it back and where to report it (Qiwa, 19911).
- [Final Exit vs Re-Entry Visa Saudi Arabia — Which to Use](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/final-exit-vs-exit-reentry-visa.html): Final exit or exit re-entry? One is a round trip, the other ends your residency. Fees, validity, what to clear first and the lifted 3-year re-entry ban.
- [Exit Re-Entry Visa Fee Calculator Saudi Arabia](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/exit-reentry-calculator.html): Calculate your exit re-entry visa fee: SAR 200 single, SAR 500 multiple, plus extra months, for you and family. How to issue it in Absher and late rules.

## Salary, GOSI and working conditions
- [Salary Calculator Saudi Arabia — Your Real Take-Home Pay](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/salary-calculator.html): Work out your real take-home pay in Saudi Arabia: no income tax, GOSI for Saudis and expats, three payslip examples and what to check in job offers.
- [GOSI Calculator Saudi Arabia — Employee & Employer Rates](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/gosi-calculator.html): See what goes to GOSI each month: 9.75% or 10.75% for Saudis, 0% for expats, employer shares, the SAR 45,000 cap and the new-entrant phase-in table.
- [Gross to Net Salary Saudi Arabia — Take-Home Pay Table](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/gross-to-net-salary-saudi-arabia.html): Gross-to-net table for expats (0% GOSI) and Saudis (9.75–10.75%), three real payslips, why the basic/allowance split matters and how to compare job offers.
- [Overtime Calculator Saudi Arabia — Are You Paid Fairly?](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/overtime-calculator.html): Work out your Saudi overtime pay under Article 107: hourly wage plus 50% of basic, rest-day and holiday hours, Ramadan limits and what to do if unpaid.
- [Working Hours in Saudi Arabia — Daily Limits & Ramadan Hours](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/working-hours-calculator.html): Saudi working hours explained: 8 a day, 48 a week, 6 in Ramadan, breaks, rest days and the 12-hour limit, plus a calculator for Article 107 extra hours.
- [Annual Leave Calculator Saudi Arabia — 21 or 30 Days](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/leave-calculator.html): Work out your Saudi annual leave: 21 days a year, 30 after 5 years, payout of unused days when you leave, other paid leave and public holidays.
- [Sick & Maternity Leave Saudi Arabia — 30/60/30 Days](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/sick-leave-maternity-leave-saudi-arabia.html): Saudi sick leave: 30 days full pay, 60 at 75%, 30 unpaid. Maternity leave is 12 weeks' full pay since 2025, paternity 3 days. Seha certificates.

## Iqama and residency
- [Iqama Expiry Calculator & Renewal Planner — Saudi Arabia](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/iqama-expiry-calculator.html): Count the days to your iqama expiry and get reminder dates. What renewal costs, who renews it, the SAR 500 late fine and a simple 90-day renewal timeline.
- [Iqama Renewal Fees Saudi Arabia — Full Cost, Line by Line](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/iqama-renewal-fees.html): What an iqama renewal really costs: SAR 650 iqama fee, SAR 800 monthly worker levy, SAR 400 per dependant, insurance and the SAR 500 late fine.
- [Renew Iqama With an Expired Passport — Absher & Muqeem](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/renew-iqama-with-expired-passport.html): Can't renew your iqama because your passport expired? Renew the passport, update it in Absher or Muqeem, then renew the iqama. Who updates what, fines.
- [Iqama Transfer Without Employer Approval — Qiwa Steps](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/iqama-transfer-calculator.html): Transfer your iqama to a new employer through Qiwa: the steps, when you don't need your current employer's approval, who pays the SAR 2,000–6,000 fee.
- [Muqeem Visa Check & Saudi Visa Check Online — Step by Step](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/muqeem-visa-check.html): Check a Saudi visa in two minutes: your own exit re-entry in Absher, a family member's on Muqeem, and visas issued abroad on the MOFA portal.
- [5-Year Resident ID Saudi Arabia vs Your Iqama Expiry](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/5-year-resident-id-guide-2026.html): The Saudi Resident ID lasts 5 years, but your iqama renews every 3–12 months. Check your real expiry in Absher and what to do if the card is lost.
- [Saudi Premium Residency Cost Calculator — Is It Worth It?](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/premium-residency-cost-calculator.html): Compare all seven Saudi Premium Residency products (SAR 4,000 to 800,000) and see if escaping the SAR 400 monthly dependent fee covers the cost for you.

## Family, dependents and visas
- [Dependent Fee Calculator Saudi Arabia — SAR 400 Per Month](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/dependent-levy-calculator.html): Calculate your Saudi dependent fee: SAR 400 per family member per month, paid at iqama renewal. Cost table, a real example and how to pay through SADAD.
- [Family Visa Cost Calculator Saudi Arabia — Real Total Cost](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/family-visa-cost-calculator.html): Add up the real cost of bringing your family to Saudi Arabia: SAR 2,000 visa fee, iqama cards, insurance, the SAR 400 monthly fee, or a visit visa instead.
- [Family Visit Visa Saudi Arabia — Apply, Fees, Stay, Extend](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/family-visit-visa-guide.html): Invite parents, spouse or children on a Saudi family visit visa: where to apply, documents, the SAR 300 fee, insurance, length of stay and extensions.
- [Family Residence Visa Saudi Arabia — Sponsor Your Family](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/family-residence-visa.html): How expats sponsor a wife and children in Saudi Arabia: who qualifies, attestation, the SAR 2,000 visa fee, embassy stamping and the SAR 400 monthly fee.
- [Musaned Domestic Worker Cost Calculator — First-Year Cost](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/musaned-calculator.html): What hiring a housemaid, nanny or driver through Musaned costs: SAR 2,000 visa fee, recruitment fee caps by nationality, contract authentication, salary.
- [Umrah Visa Guide — eVisa, Nusuk Permit & Iqama Holders](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/umrah-visa-guide.html): How to perform Umrah from inside or outside Saudi Arabia: Nusuk permit for iqama holders, tourist eVisa, Rawdah booking, costs and Hajj-season pauses.

## Arabic (العربية)
- [أدلة وحاسبات للمقيمين في السعودية بالعربية](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/ar/guides.html): أدلة عملية وحاسبات مجانية للمقيم في السعودية: الراتب والتأمينات ونهاية الخدمة والإجازات وتجديد الإقامة وتأشيرات الخروج ورسوم المرافقين.
- [حاسبة نهاية الخدمة في السعودية 2026 | حساب المكافأة](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/ar/ksa-eos-calculator.html): حاسبة نهاية الخدمة في السعودية مجانًا: احسب مكافأة نهاية الخدمة عند الاستقالة أو إنهاء العقد وفق المادتين 84 و85 من نظام العمل.
- [حاسبة التأمينات الاجتماعية في السعودية 2026 (GOSI)](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/ar/gosi-calculator.html): احسب اشتراك التأمينات الاجتماعية GOSI للموظف وصاحب العمل حسب الأجر الأساسي وبدل السكن والنِسب المعتمدة لعام 2026.
- [حاسبة الراتب في السعودية 2026 | حساب صافي الراتب](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/ar/salary-calculator.html): حاسبة الراتب في السعودية: احسب صافي راتبك الشهري بعد بدل السكن والنقل وخصم التأمينات الاجتماعية — مجانًا ومحدثة 2026.
- [حاسبة انتهاء الإقامة في السعودية | الأيام المتبقية](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/ar/iqama-expiry-calculator.html): احسب المدة المتبقية على انتهاء إقامتك في السعودية بالأيام والأشهر، واعرف موعد بدء التجديد لتفادي غرامة التأخير.
- [فترة الإشعار في نظام العمل السعودي — 30 أو 60 يومًا؟](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/ar/notice-period-saudi-labour-law.html): فترة الإشعار في السعودية بعد تعديلات 2025: 30 يومًا عند الاستقالة و60 يومًا عند إنهاء صاحب العمل، وبدل الإشعار والعقود محددة المدة.
- [رسوم تجديد الإقامة في السعودية — التكلفة الكاملة](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/ar/iqama-renewal-fees.html): كم تكلّف الإقامة فعلًا؟ رسوم الإقامة 650 ريالًا، مقابل مالي 800 شهريًا، 400 لكل مرافق، التأمين الطبي وغرامة التأخر 500 ريال، مع حاسبة.
- [حاسبة المستحقات النهائية في السعودية عند ترك العمل](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/ar/final-settlement-calculator.html): اجمع مستحقاتك النهائية قبل التوقيع: الراتب المتأخر ومكافأة نهاية الخدمة وبدل الإجازة والإشعار، ناقص الخصومات النظامية، ومهلة الدفع.
- [حاسبة الإجازة السنوية في السعودية — 21 أو 30 يومًا](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/ar/leave-calculator.html): احسب رصيد إجازتك السنوية: 21 يومًا في السنة و30 يومًا بعد 5 سنوات، وقيمة الأيام غير المستخدمة التي تُدفع لك عند ترك العمل.
- [حاسبة العمل الإضافي في السعودية — المادة 107](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/ar/overtime-calculator.html): احسب أجر ساعات العمل الإضافي في السعودية: أجر الساعة + 50% من الأساسي، وساعات الجمعة والعطل ورمضان، مع أمثلة من كشف الراتب.
- [رسوم تأشيرة الخروج والعودة في السعودية — حاسبة](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/ar/exit-reentry-calculator.html): احسب رسوم الخروج والعودة: مفردة 200 ريال لشهرين ثم 100 لكل شهر، ومتعددة 500 ريال لثلاثة أشهر ثم 200، لك ولعائلتك، وكيف تُصدر التأشيرة.
- [حاسبة رسوم المرافقين في السعودية — 400 ريال شهريًا](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/ar/dependent-levy-calculator.html): احسب رسوم المرافقين على إقامتك: 400 ريال لكل فرد شهريًا (4,800 سنويًا)، مع جدول للأسرة وطريقة السداد وأخطاء شائعة تُكلّف المال.
- [ماذا يحدث لإقامتك إذا استقلت؟ مهلة الـ60 يومًا](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/ar/what-happens-to-iqama-if-you-resign.html): الاستقالة لا تلغي إقامتك. مهلة 60 يومًا لنقل الخدمات عبر قوى أو الخروج النهائي، وكيف تتجنب بلاغ التغيّب «هروب» وتحفظ مكافأتك.
- [الراتب غير مدفوع في السعودية؟ حقوقك والخطوات](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/ar/salary-not-paid-saudi-arabia.html): تأخر راتبك؟ حقوقك في حماية الأجور، كيف تشتكي عبر قوى، النقل دون موافقة صاحب العمل، والمغادرة وفق المادة 81 مع مكافأة كاملة.
- [الخروج النهائي أم الخروج والعودة؟ الفرق والرسوم](https://www.saudiutilityhub.com/ar/final-exit-vs-exit-reentry-visa.html): الفرق بين الخروج النهائي والخروج والعودة في السعودية: الرسوم والصلاحية وما يحدث لإقامتك، وما تسدده قبل السفر وهل هناك منع من العودة.
